text:
I found 10 problems. They are in the layout, `robots.txt`, the sitemap, the two JSON-LD blocks and the Astro setup. I read all 9 tracked files but didn't run a build.

## Critical

1. **`src/layouts/Base.astro:9`: the default robots meta is `max-snippet:0`.** Every page without an explicit `robots` prop (home and moorings) forbids text snippets. That removes your text from Google result snippets and AI Overviews, and AI answer engines may not quote you either.
   - Fix: default to `index, follow, max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large`.

2. **`src/layouts/Base.astro:8`: the canonical URL is hardcoded to `https://harbor.example/` on every page.** `/moorings` and `/contact` both declare the home page as canonical, so search engines may drop them as duplicates.
   - Fix: use `new URL(Astro.url.pathname, Astro.site)`.

3. **`public/robots.txt:4-8`: `OAI-SearchBot` and `PerplexityBot` are blocked.** This keeps you out of ChatGPT Search and Perplexity citations, which is the opposite of what you want for AI search visibility.
   - Fix: remove both blocks, or change them to `Allow: /`.
   - Also consider whether to allow `GPTBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `Google-Extended` and `anthropic-ai`. Those relate to training, not search, so that is a policy choice.

4. **`src/data/faq.json:8`: the first answer's key is `" "` instead of `"acceptedAnswer"`.** The first FAQ Question has no valid answer, so the FAQPage markup is invalid and that rich result will be rejected.
   - Fix: rename the key to `"acceptedAnswer"`.

5. **`src/pages/moorings.astro:9`: the Article JSON-LD has a trailing comma after `"headline"`.** That is invalid JSON, so parsers ignore the whole block.
   - Fix: remove the comma.
   - The block also lacks `author`, `datePublished`, `dateModified` and `publisher`.
   - The page is a pricing page, so `Article` is probably the wrong type. Consider `Service` or `Offer`/`LocalBusiness` instead.

## Important

6. **`src/pages/contact.astro:4`: `robots="noindex"` on the contact page, which `public/sitemap.xml:5` lists.** The sitemap and the page disagree. Contact details are also something people and AI assistants look for.
   - Fix: drop `noindex`, or remove the page from the sitemap if the `noindex` is intentional.

7. **`src/pages/index.astro:8`: FAQPage JSON-LD with no matching FAQ text on the page.** Google requires marked-up content to be visible, and AI engines can't cite answers that aren't in the HTML.
   - Fix: render the questions and answers from `faq.json` in the page body.
   - Fix: serialize with `.replace(/</g, "\\u003c")` so the `set:html` output can't close the script tag.

8. **There is no `astro.config.mjs`.** The `package.json` has no `site` setting, so canonical URLs, the sitemap and `Astro.site` can't work. `@astrojs/preact` is also installed but never registered, so `<Newsletter client:load />` at `src/pages/moorings.astro:11` will fail to build.
   - Fix: add `astro.config.mjs` with `site` and `integrations: [preact()]`, and add `preact` to the dependencies.
   - Consider replacing the hand-written `public/sitemap.xml` with `@astrojs/sitemap` and adding `lastmod`.

## Minor

9. **`src/layouts/Base.astro:4-10`: the head is thin.**
   - Missing: `<meta charset>`, `<meta name="viewport">` (needed for mobile-first indexing), and Open Graph/Twitter tags (`og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:image`).
   - Missing: a favicon, and `Organization` or `LocalBusiness` JSON-LD with name, address, phone and opening hours. That would help entity recognition and local search.

10. **Content is thin and inconsistent.**
    - `src/pages/index.astro:5` says "Harbor … Cornwall", while the copy elsewhere says "harbour" (British spelling). Pick one, since search queries will be "harbour".
    - `src/pages/index.astro:7` and `src/pages/moorings.astro:7` are one-sentence pages. The price ("from £40 a night") sits in a bare paragraph, with no table of mooring sizes or seasons for AI engines to quote.
    - The contact page has no address, hours or email.
    - There are no internal links beyond the nav.
    - `src/components/Newsletter.jsx:2`: the `<button>` has no `type`, and the form has no `action` or handler.

I haven't changed any files. I can apply fixes 1–8 if you'd like.
